rationale_overall: Q2 2025 was a volatile-but-resolving quarter: an early-April tariff shock gave way to a sharp recovery, with the S&P 500 back to new all-time highs by June 27. Every wave already represented in the watchlist kept building rather than cresting or breaking: AI mega-caps posted strong prints (MSFT FY25 Q3 revenue +13%, Azure +20%; NVDA FQ1 revenue +69% YoY plus new Saudi/UAE chip deals), rockets/spacecraft advanced (RKLB Q1 revenue +32% YoY; KRMN Q1 revenue +21% YoY; ASTS won FCC Band 14 FirstNet test authorization), nuclear stayed in pre-revenue buildup (OKLO raised fresh equity in June to fund the Aurora buildout), quantum consolidated capability (IONQ's $1.075B agreement to acquire Oxford Ionics, June 9), the defense wave got a fresh multi-year tailwind (NATO's June 24-25 Hague pledge to 5% of GDP by 2035, bearing on ITA), and demographics kept its slow grind (WELL Q1 FFO +18.8% YoY). No holding showed a thesis breach or an un-priced peak signal, and no outside candidate cleared the bar for a swap at the 12-ticker cap. Net effect: watchlist unchanged this quarter.
